answer: Farming becomes a ripple bet on surviving 92 epochs of grading, and every forge settlement recomputes the basalt schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 92 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
